{"sql": "WITH heights AS (
  SELECT MAX(height) as max_height, MIN(height) as min_height
  FROM player
),
tallest_player AS (
  SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name
  FROM player p
  CROSS JOIN heights h
  WHERE p.height = h.max_height
  LIMIT 1
),
shortest_player AS (
  SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name
  FROM player p
  CROSS JOIN heights h
  WHERE p.height = h.min_height
  LIMIT 1
),
finishing_comparison AS (
  SELECT tp.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) as avg_finishing
  FROM tallest_player tp
  JOIN player_attributes pa ON tp.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
  GROUP BY tp.player_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sp.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) as avg_finishing
  FROM shortest_player sp
  JOIN player_attributes pa ON sp.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
  GROUP BY sp.player_name
)
SELECT player_name
FROM finishing_comparison
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1"}

{"sql": "WITH single_bonded_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bond.molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT AVG(subquery.oxygen_count)
FROM (
  SELECT sbm.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
  FROM single_bonded_molecules sbm
  LEFT JOIN atom ON sbm.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id AND atom.element = 'o'
  GROUP BY sbm.molecule_id
) subquery"}

{"sql": "WITH double_bond_molecules AS (

)

  / NULLIF(COUNT(atom.atom_id), 0) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
JOIN double_bond_molecules ON atom.molecule_id = double_bond_molecules.molecule_id"}

{"sql": "WITH atoms_in_single_bonds AS (
  SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element
  FROM bond
  JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
  JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
  WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element
  FROM bond
  JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
  JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id2 = atom.atom_id
  WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
)

  SUM(CASE WHEN atoms_in_single_bonds.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / 
  NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 as percentage
FROM atoms_in_single_bonds"}

{"sql": "WITH youngest_with_salary AS (
  SELECT client.client_id, client.birth_date, district.a11
  FROM client
  JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
  WHERE client.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
)
SELECT account.account_id
FROM youngest_with_salary
JOIN disp ON youngest_with_salary.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE youngest_with_salary.a11 = (SELECT MAX(a11) FROM youngest_with_salary)"}

{"sql": "WITH female_clients_with_salary AS (
  SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.birth_date,
    d.a11
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
sorted_by_age AS (
  SELECT 
    client_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY birth_date ASC) as age_rank
  FROM female_clients_with_salary
),
sorted_by_salary AS (
  SELECT 
    client_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a11 ASC) as salary_rank
  FROM female_clients_with_salary
),
target_client_ids AS (
  SELECT client_id FROM sorted_by_age WHERE age_rank = 1
  UNION
  SELECT client_id FROM sorted_by_salary WHERE salary_rank = 1
),
salary_gap AS (
  SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) as gap
  FROM female_clients_with_salary
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  disp.account_id,
  salary_gap.gap
FROM disp
CROSS JOIN salary_gap
WHERE disp.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM target_client_ids)
ORDER BY disp.account_id"}

{"sql": "WITH target_account AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE loan.date = '1993-07-05'
  ORDER BY loan.loan_id
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_balances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (trans.date) trans.date, trans.balance
  FROM trans
  JOIN target_account ON trans.account_id = target_account.account_id
  WHERE trans.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27')
  ORDER BY trans.date, trans.trans_id DESC
)
SELECT (
  MAX(CASE WHEN latest_balances.date = '1998-12-27' THEN latest_balances.balance END) - 
  MAX(CASE WHEN latest_balances.date = '1993-03-22' THEN latest_balances.balance END)
) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN latest_balances.date = '1993-03-22' THEN latest_balances.balance END), 0) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM latest_balances"}

{"sql": "WITH target_clients AS (

  JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
  JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id

)

{"sql": "WITH weekly_clients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'M') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
FROM weekly_clients"}

{"sql": "WITH female_clients AS (
  SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.birth_date,
    d.a11
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
oldest_female AS (
  SELECT 
    client_id,
    birth_date,
    a11
  FROM female_clients
  WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM female_clients)
),
target_clients AS (
  SELECT 
    client_id,
    birth_date,
    a11
  FROM oldest_female
  WHERE a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM oldest_female)
)
SELECT DISTINCT disp.account_id
FROM target_clients
JOIN disp ON target_clients.client_id = disp.client_id"}
